business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Professional employer organization (PEO): payroll, HR, workers' compensation, benefits, risk management, plus staffing and recruiting

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Labor-based outsourcing: locally supported PEO teams with HRIS technology, co-employment, and clients retaining day-to-day control

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Fees based on payroll; workers' compensation premiums payroll-based, pay-as-you-go with no deposits or year-end audits

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Recurring payroll-cycle PEO services and long-term client partnerships, with core package for all clients

implementation_transition_work.label: Implementation / transition work
implementation_transition_work.value: Client onboarding to HRIS and payroll, handbook and policy development, electronic employee onboarding

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Proprietary web-based HRIS (myBBSI) accessible from any device, bundled with PEO service

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Payroll, HR administration, recruiting/applicant tracking, onboarding, timekeeping, learning management

processing_transaction_platform_7374.label: Processing / transaction platform [7374]
processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Payroll processing, tax filings, W-2 and 1099 administration through full-service PEO

staffing_placement_model_736.label: Staffing / placement model [736]
staffing_placement_model_736.value: PEO with staffing: direct placement, contract-to-hire, temporary and seasonal staffing, screening and onboarding

notes: Pricing basis, contract terms, retention and volumes are not given on the website; charging unit and economics come from general knowledge of BBSI.
